steps.title: Join
steps.description: Apply for membership with a short profile covering your professional background, current focus, and what you're looking to give and get from the network.

steps.title: Profile
steps.description: Your profile is the basis for all matching — programs, mentors, peer groups, and events are suggested based on what you're actually working on.

steps.title: Match
steps.description: Our community team reviews your profile and manually curates your first three introductions or program placements within two weeks of joining.

steps.title: Engage
steps.description: Attend your matched sessions, participate in your assigned program, and contribute to the community — the network only gets stronger with active members.

steps.title: Grow
steps.description: Track your outcomes — skills gained, relationships built, projects launched. Members who engage consistently report measurable career and business progress within six months.
